summary: Show or hide the TUI sidebar from a compact top-bar item before the connection and activity counts; the item highlights while the sidebar is shown

schema.detail: No graph, storage, or preference schema changes.

compatibility.detail: The new pointer target invokes the same sidebar toggle as Ctrl+S, preserving existing visibility persistence and focus behavior.

manual.detail: Click sidebar at the left of the top bar, choose its action from the F10 top-bar menu, or continue using Ctrl+S. Narrow terminals omit the shortcut to preserve the existing status actions and glass selector.

recovery.detail: Click sidebar again or use Ctrl+S to restore the previous visibility.
